items.name: The Dose Ledger
items.description: A cloth-bound tally book begun by hand after the first reading, its pages ruled for dates, dials, and the names of who held them. Not a medical record. A kept document.

items.name: Dosimeter Calibration Key
items.description: A brass socket-wrench key, hand-made by the clockmaker to fit the adjustment collar of every dosimeter in the bunker. It does not make the dial honest; it makes the dial honest again.

items.name: Dosimeter Tag
items.description: A stamped alloy tag lashed to a dosimeter's lanyard so the dial can be bound to one named survivor instead of to whoever happened to be nearest when the Geiger stopped screaming.

items.name: Palliative Morphine Tray
items.description: A pre-Exchange hospital tray, three ampoules of morphine sulfate and one glass syringe, kept for the named sick and nothing else. The sick room has a schedule for it. The schedule is kept.

items.name: The Children's Baseline Board
items.description: A section of chalkboard carried out of the children's corridor, numbers and half-erased guesses still legible. A memory of a baseline that was argued over, never settled.

items.name: Calibrated Quartz Dosimeter
items.description: A precision quartz-fiber electroscope dosimeter verified against Piet's calibration bench, giving trusted measurement readings without flux uncertainty.

items.name: Forged Clean-Bill Chit
items.description: A stamped administrative ledger slip bearing an imitation of Dr. Vel's red pencil signature, certifying Green-band classification regardless of true physical burden.

items.name: Chelation Decorporation Course
items.description: A clinical course of calcium trisodium DTPA and zinc-calcium decorporation ampoules, prescribed strictly for internal isotope ingestion management.

items.name: Lead-Shielded Badge Case
items.description: A lead-lined alloy badge holder designed to protect dormant photographic dosimeter film from ambient background fogging before assignment.

items.name: Pocket Dosimeter
items.description: A clip-on direct-reading quartz-fiber dosimeter with an internal optical scale and inspection stamp, measuring cumulative ionizing exposure during hazardous duties.

items.name: Radiation Survey Meter
items.description: A portable ionization chamber survey meter with a sliding beta shield and manual range selector, deployed to map ambient radiation gradients across sectors.

items.name: Dose Register Book
items.description: A hardbound administrative logbook ruled with carbon-transfer duplicates, recording assigned exposure quotas, registrar initials, and official band certifications.

items.name: Cohort Baseline Card
items.description: A stiff registry card stamped with intake dates and tracking columns for quarterly thyroid palpation and baseline exposure checks among shelter cohorts.

items.name: Examiner Shielding Apron
items.description: A heavy vinyl-clad composite apron worn during close-contact triage and screening inspections to provide localized torso attenuation against scattered radiation.

items.name: Potassium Iodide Pack
items.description: A sealed foil blister pack of stable potassium iodide tablets intended strictly for thyroid blocking prophylaxis against acute radioiodine uptake.
